blurb: Guests can rent a variety of specialty cycles, cruiser bikes, surreys, electric bikes, swan pedal boats, kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards. Rentals are available at locations including Long Beach (Rainbow Lagoon, Shoreline Village) and Minneapolis (Lake Nokomis). Night rides with LED-lit surreys and swan boats are offered seasonally. Parking validation is available at some locations.
